main_text.p: Nomina hujus declinationis, in ⊖ definentia, vel sunt masculina, vel foeminina, vel communia: in ον vero, sunt neutra, ut: ὁ λαὸς, ἡ νόσ⊖, ὁ κ⊖ ἡ ἀνθρώπ⊖: τὸ ἔργον.
[Observatio. 1. Atticis omnia composita & derivativa hujus declinationis, itemque adjectiva in ⊖ purum, μ⊖, & ρ⊖ definentia, communia sunt. ut: ὁ χ⊖ ἡ φιλόσοφ⊖, ἀρχ⊖ς. ἄστ⊖, γνώσ⊖, ἀ-φόρ⊖.
2. Neutra quaedam, attico more, abjiciunt. ut: τὸ ἄλλο, & composita cum ⊖ ⊖; τοῦτο, τοσοῦτο, τηλικοῦτο.]
Genitivus, definit in ς, ut: τῆς λόγος, τοῦ ξύλος.
Dativus, in ῳ. ut: τῷ λόγῳ, τῷ ξύλῳ.
Accusativus, in ον. ut: τὸν λόγον, τὸ ξύλον.
Vocativus, in ε, à Nominativo in ⊖; vel in ον, à Nominativo neutro. ut: ὦ λόγ⊖, ὦ ξύλον.
In duali Numero: Nominativus, Accusativus, & Vocativus, definunt in ω. ut: τὼ λόγω, ξύλω.
Genitivus & Dativus, in οιν. ut: τοῖν λόγοιν, ξύλοιν.

page.notes: Greek and some ligatured or symbol glyphs (⊖ for abbreviation signs) are approximated; the page is faded at edges. Catchword "liqui," appears at the foot right and is included as the last line.
